section: A good idea must be allowed to fail
line: A good idea must be allowed to fail.
brief: Show a real experiment with an openly visible failure outcome that the calm operator accepts and learns from; the apparatus must be capable of genuinely failing, not merely surviving adversity.

Show a powerful machine reaching a visibly separate external gate controlled by a human operator; the gate can still refuse action. Convey increased capability without increased authority, with no pseudo-text or interface lettering.

section: Keep the stop path outside the failure
line: The control loop must remain outside and operationally independent of the system it controls.
brief: Show two unmistakably distinct causal paths: one noisy or failing machine path, and one physically separate, simple, reachable operator monitoring-and-shutdown path that remains clear and functional. The failing system must not share or control the stop path. No interface text, labels, or decorative symbols.

line: Make intelligence abundant without making authority automatic.
brief: Show many cheap machine-generated proposals multiplying rapidly and converging on one narrow external authorization gate controlled separately by a human operator. Abundant proposal generation must remain visibly distinct from scarce authority.

section: Build tools that can disagree with you
line: Build tools that can say no to you.
brief: Show a useful instrument or computer visibly preventing or contradicting the operator's intended action through its physical behavior or measurement, while the operator calmly accepts the contradiction. Do not rely on written words or signs.

line: There is no special step called: Become defensive.
brief: When a claim arrives, show a calm sequence of checking reality and continuing rather than arguing, posturing, or escalating; communicate the branch structure visually without visible text.
